subject.title: feat(web): declutter shell chrome like Slack

question: Should the integrated desktop shell intentionally remove the visible app-settings button and rely on the native menu, Cmd/Ctrl+,, and tray while reserving the workspace-name button for workspace settings?
rationale: This is a user-facing discoverability tradeoff rather than a mechanically determined correctness choice, and the discussion contains no independent maintainer confirmation of the intended permanent UX.

options.title: Accept native-only app settings
options.body: Approve the simplified title bar after runtime proof confirms the retained settings routes and workspace-menu interaction.

options.title: Keep a visible settings affordance
options.body: Retain or relocate an app-settings control while still removing the duplicate workspace and connection labels.

recommendation.title: Accept native-only app settings
recommendation.body: Approve the simplified title bar after runtime proof confirms the retained settings routes and workspace-menu interaction.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only available routing candidate connected to all affected shell surfaces, though the ownership evidence is limited to this coordinated branch.
